entries.angle: The tariff story arrives at the reader's own kitchen table via the refund cheque: the Court struck the levies down and Treasury has now returned $100bn — all of it to corporations, none to the households that paid — which a governor is turning into a demand for $1,700 per family, a distribution-of-the-refund lens distinct from August 4's constitutional-authority lawsuit and July's rate-announcement coverage.
entries.headline: 關稅退款只給企業，州長要求發錢給家庭

entries.angle: A player-voice recovery-and-ambition feature — Odunze declaring his surgically repaired foot sound and setting a 1,000-yard, 100-catch target in the camp's first heavy padded session — distinct from August 5's Bryant knee injury, August 2's left-tackle battle, July 31's Indiana stadium financing and July's position-group previews.
entries.headline: 熊隊訓練營，歐頓齊說腳傷已經全好

entries.angle: The window's biggest saga ends with a signature rather than a rumour — a six-year Madrid contract to 2032 vindicates the player's camp over Arsenal's briefings and leaves the champions with a left-wing hole and only days to fill it, the closure-and-consequence phase distinct from July 26's target identification, July 29's speculative collapse and August 3's duelling-narratives story.
entries.headline: 維尼修斯續約留在皇馬，兵工廠落空

entries.angle: After a month in which the paper covered Hormuz only through closure declarations, blockades, tolls and oil prices, ships are actually crossing again — the physical reopening arriving before the diplomacy that is meant to authorise it, and still reversible.
entries.headline: 荷姆茲海峽再現油輪，有望重新開放

entries.angle: The 30 July story was a chairman scheduling a contempt vote; today that vote passed 8-7 and was routed around the full Senate straight to the Justice Department, turning a hearing-room standoff into a live prosecution decision with precedent-setting stakes for the Fifth Amendment before Congress.
entries.headline: 美參院委員會認定佛奇藐視國會

entries.angle: A doorstep story about the machinery of state licensing rather than about crime or the city budget: operators already shut down once last year for mishandling about 100 bodies were still licensed to accumulate 57 more — a fresh Chicago thread distinct from the CPS-finance, tariff-refund and public-safety-data entries of the past week.
entries.headline: 芝加哥殯儀館驚見五十七具遺體

entries.angle: A new industry and a new driver for the paper's merger coverage after media, pharma and warehouses: homebuilders are merging because high financing costs have made mid-sized builders unviable — consolidation as a symptom of the interest-rate story rather than of dealmaking appetite.
entries.headline: 美國建商合併潮再添一樁

entries.angle: The Bulls' first appearance in the paper in nearly a month, and a season-arc verdict rather than a game or a signing: the completed offseason under new EVP Bryson Graham reads as a deliberate refusal to tank — breaking a sports desk saturated by Bears camp and Cubs deadline coverage.
entries.headline: 公牛隊補強，新球季不想再墊底

entries.angle: Yesterday's Vinicius story was a target staying where he was; today a target Arsenal actively pursued is reinforcing a direct title rival — the window's cost measured in a competitor's gain rather than in Arsenal's own empty shirt.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：羅傑斯改投切爾西

entries.angle: The paper's first story on who actually runs the Justice Department: a president's former personal defence lawyer confirmed attorney general by a single vote, and the specific price — Epstein-files concessions to one senator — that bought the majority.
entries.headline: 布蘭奇以一票之差出任美國司法部長

entries.angle: For the first time the labs' voluntary safety thresholds actually bind: OpenAI withholds a finished model because it crossed its own 'critical' cyber-offence tier — a self-restraint story, distinct from the ledger's run of breach post-mortems, the kill-switch bill and the criminal-liability gap.
entries.headline: 網路攻擊能力太強，OpenAI 放慢新模型

entries.angle: The AI boom shows up in the customs data: China's record surplus is being driven by a near-doubling of semiconductor exports, making the data-centre buildout — not consumer goods — the engine of the world's biggest trade imbalance.
entries.headline: 晶片需求帶動，中國七月出口大增

entries.angle: Yesterday's paper reported the executive orders; today the courts answer with a device the reader has not seen — the first nationwide class certification of all US-born children, the workaround plaintiffs are using now that the Supreme Court has curtailed universal injunctions.
entries.headline: 法官擋下新命令，保護在美出生的孩子

entries.angle: A position group collapses rather than a single player going down: with a third safety lost, the Bears are signing free agents off the street mid-camp — a roster-construction crisis distinct from earlier injury bulletins and camp features.
entries.headline: 安全衛接連受傷，熊隊急著補人

entries.angle: The window closes and the ledger's two failures (Vinicius, Rogers) get their answer: the one marquee arrival is confirmed and signed, and the question becomes what a £75m holding midfielder — rather than the winger Arteta wanted — does to the champions' shape days from the Community Shield.
entries.headline: 兵工廠七千五百萬英鎊簽下布魯諾

entries.angle: The reopening the paper reported on August 8 goes into reverse — Tehran refuses direct talks and a refinery strike reignites the squeeze — and for the first time the cost is measured not in tanker crossings but in American interest rates, with markets now pricing Fed hikes rather than cuts.
entries.headline: 荷姆茲談判破局，油價漲破八十四美元

entries.angle: A country of 130 million quietly slides back toward the civil war the world declared over in 2022 — a brand-new international thread for the paper that breaks a fortnight in which every world story ran through the Gulf.
entries.headline: 提格雷再度開戰，衣索比亞和平協議動搖

entries.angle: A central bank finally puts numbers on the AI-jobs question and finds the displacement everyone argues about has not shown up in the data — an evidence lens the ledger's month of model releases, safety breaches, lab politics and market swings has never touched.
entries.headline: 紐約聯準銀行研究：人工智慧改變徵人，沒造成失業潮

entries.angle: A dispute over a ballroom becomes a clean constitutional question the paper has never run — whether a president can alter federal property without Congress — with the demolition already done and only a two-week stay standing between the ruling and the Supreme Court.
entries.headline: 上訴法院：白宮宴會廳要國會同意才能蓋

entries.angle: The deadline story finally becomes a baseball story: the rotation Chicago spent prospects to fix is producing — Gausman seven scoreless in his debut, Boyd to 8-1, an 18-hit rout — the on-field verdict on the front-office moves the paper covered on August 3 and 4.
entries.headline: 小熊敲十八支安打，十比二大勝皇家

entries.angle: The window's spending is judged by what happened on the pitch rather than by fees: the champions' last rehearsal before the Community Shield was undone by three teenagers, exposing the defence Arsenal spent the summer not reinforcing while the money went to midfield.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：多特蒙德三比二擊敗兵工廠

entries.angle: A brand-new topic for the paper: an executive order that does not argue about vaccines but rewrites the federal schedule itself — 18 diseases cut to 11, MMR split into three — turning a rhetorical fight into an administrative instruction that insurers and schools are legally tied to.
entries.headline: 川普下令，兒童疫苗從十八種減到十一種

entries.angle: The compute crunch reaches a new class of landlord — a frontier lab signs a 20-year lease on a bitcoin miner's Texas power campus, showing that what labs are now buying is grid interconnection, not chips, and that crypto's stranded-energy estate is being converted into AI capacity.
entries.headline: 人工智慧公司砸九十一億美元，租下比特幣礦場

entries.angle: A brand-new world story that breaks a fortnight in which almost every international entry ran through the Gulf: Colombia's strongest quake in a century, with the hospital wards that collapsed making the point that the casualty toll is a function of building stock rather than of magnitude.
entries.headline: 哥倫比亞百年最強地震，一百三十二人死亡

entries.angle: The city's first Chicago entry in three issues, and an adaptation-policy lens rather than a disaster one: cooling capacity is being rationed by a Heat Vulnerability Index, with 13 of 20 extended pools placed in the most at-risk neighbourhoods — heat treated as a public-health inequality to be targeted, not a weather event to be endured.
entries.headline: 芝加哥二十座泳池，延長開到勞動節

entries.angle: An individual-awards lens rather than a team result: PCA overtakes Ohtani as NL MVP frontrunner on a case built substantially on centre-field defence, distinct from August 10's 'the new rotation is producing' game story and from July's All-Star, 20-20 and Statcast-catch milestones.
entries.headline: 小熊外野手超越大谷，成最有價值球員大熱門

entries.angle: A definitive prognosis rather than a match report or a fee: surgery is avoided but both first-choice defenders are formally ruled out of the Community Shield and probably the opener, converting the summer's unaddressed defensive gap into a named, dated availability problem — distinct from August 10's Dortmund-defeat post-mortem and July 21's 'four-to-five months, possibly surgical' scare.
entries.headline: 兵工廠兩大後衛受傷，錯過社區盾杯

entries.angle: The financing structure of the AI buildout, not its price or its power supply: compute is being securitised into a borrowable asset class, pushing the risk of an AI bust out of tech balance sheets and into private credit and asset managers.
entries.headline: 輝達拉來六大金主 籌五千億美元建AI機房

entries.angle: A brand-new international thread for the paper: a 468-88 parliamentary vote converts a four-decade insurgency into a legal disarmament-for-pardon mechanism, and the PKK's immediate rejection of its terms shows the deal is legislated but not agreed.
entries.headline: 土耳其國會通過特赦 庫德武裝團體不買帳

entries.angle: The merger fight escalates from courtrooms to corporate hostage-taking: the acquirer threatens to relocate out of California entirely unless the state drops its antitrust suit, with a $7m-a-day penalty clock forcing the deadline.
entries.headline: 派拉蒙嗆搬離加州 州檢察長批勒索

entries.angle: A back-page science pick with a same-day hook and no precedent in the ledger: the first total solar eclipse over mainland Spain in 121 years, arriving at sunset and beginning an unusually tight three-eclipse sequence for one country.
entries.headline: 日全食今掃過冰島與西班牙 已等一百二十一年

entries.angle: The worry Whittingham named when camp opened is easing: five practices in, the offensive line is outperforming his own warning, the left tackle job is a three-man fight, and a non-headline receiver emerges as the staff's first breakout endorsement — an evaluation angle, not another camp-opening scene-setter.
entries.headline: 密大教頭改口 誇進攻線比預期好

entries.angle: Yesterday's injury bulletin becomes a spending decision: with both first-choice centre-backs out, Arsenal's remaining window budget is being redirected from the winger Arteta chased all summer to centre-backs — including Tottenham's captain — after €167.5m already spent.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：後衛倒一片 阿爾特塔改買中後衛

entries.angle: Five days after the paper reported OpenAI withholding a model for crossing its own critical cyber-offence threshold, the lab does the opposite - shipping a deliberately less-refusing offensive-security model to vetted customers, which has already found two live Chrome zero-days - turning containment into gatekeeping and making the screening process, not the model, the safety mechanism.
entries.headline: OpenAI 推出資安模型，只開放給通過審查的客戶

entries.angle: The deep-strike campaign is no longer occasional or symbolic - four strikes in three days, the newest 800 miles inside Russia at a refinery near the Urals, showing Ukraine has turned refining capacity into a systematically bombarded industrial front rather than a headline-grabbing raid.
entries.headline: 烏克蘭無人機深入八百英里，炸俄國大煉油廠

entries.angle: The war premium has drained out of the market - Iran attacked two Emirati tankers in the strait and oil still fell more than 2% while US equities hit a record, an inversion of the 10 August story in which the same conflict was pushing crude and American interest rates up.
entries.headline: 美股創新高，油價反而下跌

entries.angle: The cheap-Chinese-AI story reverses: the company that built its name on undercutting Western labs is now raising API prices and rationing by peak and off-peak hours, conceding that compute costs bind it too - an economics-of-inference angle distinct from the 1 August benchmark-beating-budget-model story.
entries.headline: DeepSeek 推出新模型，同時大幅漲價

entries.angle: The first real preseason-usage decision of the Bears' year: a defending division champion holds its franchise quarterback out of Saturday's opener entirely and hands the game to Tyson Bagent - a risk-management choice, not another injury bulletin or position battle.
entries.headline: 熊隊季前賽首戰，威廉斯不上場

entries.angle: The summer's injuries and transfer misses finally become a starting eleven: with Saliba and Timber doubtful and Rice and Saka expected to be rested after the World Cup, Arteta faces Manchester City in Saturday's Community Shield with Mosquera and Ben White at centre-back and Madueke and Zubimendi promoted - a selection-and-fixture lens, not another injury prognosis or transfer target.
entries.headline: 兵工廠對曼城，社區盾為新球季揭幕

entries.angle: The summer's macro story finally shows up in the household ledger rather than in oil prices or Fed statements — July retail sales post their worst month in over a year and August sentiment drops about 8%, meaning the squeeze the paper has tracked through Hormuz and the bond market has now reached what Americans actually spend.
entries.headline: 美國七月零售銷售大跌，消費信心跟著下滑

entries.angle: Three days after the paper described AI compute being securitised into a new asset class, the market prices the downside for the first time — a bank puts a $370bn debt number on one company's off-balance-sheet AI vehicle and its shares fall 5-6% with a downgrade, turning a financing innovation into a credit problem.
entries.headline: 博通股價重挫，人工智慧的借錢模式引發擔心

entries.angle: The war measured in sailors rather than in barrels or missiles — a 240-day unbroken carrier deployment produces mouldy water, a mental-health crisis and a public rebuke from the president, the first time the paper covers the Iran campaign as a question of military sustainability and human cost.
entries.headline: 林肯號官兵家屬喊苦，川普說時間還不夠長

entries.angle: Illinois starts paying for its own disasters: with a record 200-plus tornadoes this year and federal aid requests rejected, the state routes flood-repair money through two neighbourhood home-equity programmes — adaptation financed locally because Washington declined, distinct from 11 August's heat-vulnerability rationing story.
entries.headline: 伊利諾州自己出錢救水災，今年龍捲風破紀錄

entries.angle: The Cubs' pitching problem moves from the rotation to the bullpen: on the same night a deadline starter delivers a home shutout, a key reliever is lost for the season to a torn patellar tendon — a bullpen-attrition angle distinct from 10 August's 'the new rotation is producing' rout and 11 August's PCA MVP case.
entries.headline: 小熊三比零完封紅雀，後援投手梅頓恐報銷

entries.angle: Arteta closes the door the paper reported he was opening: with only three fit senior centre-backs and Timber now weeks rather than days away, the manager rules out an emergency defensive signing — the summer's unfilled defensive gap will be lived with, not bought out, reversing 12 August's 'budget redirected to centre-backs' story.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：中後衛只剩三人，阿爾特塔不急著補人

entries.angle: The ceasefire architecture is unravelling on a second, land front — the deadliest Israeli strikes in Lebanon since June's Hezbollah truce — rather than at the Gulf chokepoint the paper has covered all month through oil prices, tanker crossings and carrier crews.
entries.headline: 以色列空襲黎巴嫩，十一人死亡

entries.angle: The bubble argument gets tested from the demand side for once — actual enterprise revenue tripling in eight months and $1m-plus customers doubling in under two months — an income-statement lens the ledger's month of capex, securitisation and credit-risk stories never touched.
entries.headline: 產業報告：Anthropic 年營收增為三倍

entries.angle: Immigration seen from the opposition bench rather than the executive or the courts: the DNC passes two contradictory ICE resolutions on the same day, a party incapable of naming its own position four months from the midterms.
entries.headline: 民主黨同一天通過兩種相反主張

entries.angle: A brand-new international thread for the paper and a different hemisphere from a fortnight of Gulf and Ukraine coverage: Northeast Asia's memory politics as a live diplomatic instrument, read through a nationalist PM sending an offering instead of attending.
entries.headline: 日相只送供品，中韓仍抗議

entries.angle: Not a Cubs result but a record set against them — the first player in MLB history to homer in his first three at-bats did it at Wrigley — a history-made-by-the-opponent lens distinct from this week's rotation-verdict, MVP-case and bullpen-attrition entries.
entries.headline: 紅雀新人前三打席連三轟，小熊吞敗

entries.angle: The season's first competitive fixture as an audit of the summer rather than a team-sheet projection: €167m spent on midfield, no winger, an unreinforced defence and one win in five in pre-season, all going on trial against City at 9am Chicago time.
entries.headline: 兵工廠今開季戰曼城，社區盾在卡地夫

entries.angle: The coalition that brokered the postwar plan turns on Israel: six Arab and Muslim governments issue a joint statement blaming Israel for the stall while Kushner shuttles to Cairo — the mediators-versus-Israel phase, distinct from 1 August's 'Hamas accepts disarmament' breakthrough and from this month's Lebanon/Gulf strands of the war.
entries.headline: 阿拉伯八國指責以色列，庫許納趕赴開羅救和平計畫

entries.angle: A brand-new US policy thread for the paper: the fight over youth gender medicine moves from rhetoric and state legislatures into a finalized federal payment rule with a date on it (13 October) and a grace period, forcing state Medicaid agencies to choose between dropping coverage and paying for it alone.
entries.headline: 美國新規定：聯邦不再出錢付未成年變性醫療

entries.angle: The 11 August Riot–Anthropic lease gets its market verdict: bitcoin is down 44% while miners are up 43–152%, meaning equity investors have stopped valuing the sector on hash rate and started valuing it on hyperscaler contracts — the AI buildout repricing a whole industry, not a single deal.
entries.headline: 比特幣大跌，挖礦公司股價卻飛上天

entries.angle: The Gulf oil shock the paper has tracked through tanker crossings, Brent prices and US retail sales now lands on the Bank of Japan's desk: a Q2 growth miss of nearly half the forecast, driven by stalled consumption, that puts next month's planned rate rise in doubt.
entries.headline: 日本第二季成長不到預期一半，央行升息計畫生變

entries.angle: A city-rivalry lens rather than a scoreboard one: the Crosstown Series opens tonight at Wrigley with both Chicago clubs in the playoff conversation, a civic frame distinct from the past week's rotation-verdict, PCA MVP-case, bullpen-attrition and opponent-record entries.
entries.headline: 跨城大戰今晚開打，小熊主場迎戰白襪

entries.angle: The summer's audit gets its verdict on the pitch: the makeshift defence the paper has worried about all month kept a clean sheet against City in a 3-0 Community Shield win, with a goal inside 24 seconds — the result phase of the fixture previewed on 16 August, and the first trophy of the title defence.
entries.headline: 兵工廠三比零踢下曼城，捧回社區盾

entries.angle: A payments company buys the switchboard between developers and every frontier model for $7bn — five times its valuation three months ago — showing the contested prize in AI has moved to the routing layer, a market-structure and M&A lens distinct from the ledger's month of capex, securitisation, credit-risk and revenue-growth stories.
entries.headline: 支付公司Stripe七十億美元買下AI「轉接台」

entries.angle: The war's diplomatic architecture, not its battlefield or its oil price: the president's own 60-day Versailles ultimatum expires with nothing agreed, he declares deadlines meaningless, and he threatens to bomb Oman — a mediator — distinct from 15 August's carrier-sustainability story and 16 August's Lebanon strikes.
entries.headline: 美伊六十天期限到期 川普放話要炸阿曼

entries.angle: A structural-stagnation lens on the world's second-largest economy — output, consumption and investment all missing at once, reviving the Japanification debate weeks before October trade talks — a country and a diagnosis the paper has not run, distinct from 17 August's Japan Q2 miss and 15 August's US retail-sales story.
entries.headline: 中國七月數據全面走弱 學者談「日本化」

entries.angle: A back-page science finding that cuts against the premise of laws the paper has already reported: eight years of Finnish longitudinal data associate more screen time with better teenage cognitive processing, complicating Illinois's classroom phone ban and its app-design mandates.
entries.headline: 芬蘭八年研究：多看螢幕的孩子 長大反應更好

entries.angle: The roster-construction phase rather than a game story: the day after the 34-10 preseason opener that Williams sat out, the Bears sign a veteran pass-rusher and start cutting, turning camp evaluation into subtraction — the consequence of 14 August's 'hold the quarterback out' decision, and a break from a Cubs-heavy sports desk.
entries.headline: 熊隊季前賽大勝 隔天就動刀換人

entries.angle: The season arc rather than a result: with the Shield won, the question becomes whether a club defending an English title for the first time in over twenty years can do it with its best defender out and the deepest chasing pack in years — a nine-month horizon distinct from 17 August's Shield result and 16 August's single-fixture audit.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：二十二年來第一次以冠軍開季 卻少了最強後衛

entries.angle: The frontier labs turn their own products into age-gated environments: OpenAI ships a restricted teen ChatGPT governed by an age-prediction system that classifies users without asking them — a consumer-product and child-safety lens the ledger's month of capex, securitisation, credit risk, cyber-offence and lab-politics stories has never touched.
entries.headline: OpenAI推出青少年版ChatGPT，靠系統猜你幾歲

entries.angle: The ballroom fight moves from the appellate ruling this paper reported on August 10 to the Supreme Court's emergency docket with a hard August 21 deadline — the question shifting from whether the president needed Congress to whether the justices will pause a ruling when the building has already been torn down.
entries.headline: 白宮舞廳工程喊停，最高法院兩天內要決定

entries.angle: A brand-new science thread for the paper and a rare case of AI being used on the mitigation side of the climate ledger rather than the emissions side: an entire ocean's airspace becomes a live experiment in steering planes around machine-predicted contrails.
entries.headline: 英國與Google啟動AI試驗，幫飛機避開凝結尾

entries.angle: Where August 15 showed Illinois improvising its own repair money after Washington said no, today the state uses a formal disaster proclamation over 15 named counties to reopen a different federal door — block-grant disaster funding — turning a workaround into a legal instrument.
entries.headline: 普利茲克簽災難聲明，十五個郡可申請聯邦補助

entries.angle: The Cubs' attrition moves from the bullpen (August 15) to the middle of the diamond: an everyday shortstop lost for four to six weeks forces Hoerner across the bag and reshapes the whole infield in a playoff race — a roster-reconfiguration angle, not another game result or milestone.
entries.headline: 小熊游擊手史旺森側腹拉傷，預計休四到六週

entries.angle: The league campaign itself begins: Friday's opener against a promoted Coventry side is where the £167m summer stops being a Shield-day audit and becomes a 38-game defence, with the record signing Tzolis in line for his first Premier League start — a specific opening-fixture and selection lens rather than August 18's nine-month season-arc essay.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：新球季首戰主場對考文垂

entries.angle: The frontier race reaches the public markets: OpenAI names a year for its IPO, which would force the sector's most-argued-about balance sheet into audited quarterly disclosure — a capital-markets and ownership lens distinct from the ledger's month of capex, securitisation, credit-risk, revenue-growth and M&A stories.
entries.headline: OpenAI 說 2027 年要上市

entries.angle: A brand-new fiscal thread for the paper: the debt crosses $40tn years ahead of official projections, and the story is the interest bill — near $1.2tn a year, now bigger than defence — arriving precisely as this summer's higher long-term yields reprice the whole stock.
entries.headline: 美國國債首度突破 40 兆美元

entries.angle: The Gulf states stop hedging: Iran's second-largest trading partner and its main sanctions-evasion channel severs commercial ties outright — an economic-isolation-by-neighbours lens distinct from 18 August's expired ultimatum, 16 August's Lebanon strikes, 15 August's carrier-crew story and the month's oil-price coverage.
entries.headline: 阿聯酋停止與伊朗所有貿易

entries.angle: The tariff fight comes home to North America and to a never-used statute: 50% levies on Canada are deferred by three days under Section 338 of the 1930 Tariff Act, the third distinct legal theory the administration has reached for — distinct from 24 July's forced-labour blanket, 4 August's 25-state lawsuit and 7 August's refund-distribution story.
entries.headline: 美國對加拿大的五成關稅延後三天

entries.angle: Camp's open questions start closing: the left-tackle competition Whittingham called a three-man fight on 12 August resolves to Babalola for Week One, and Underwood's practice reviews give the new staff its first concrete evaluation of its quarterback — a decision-and-verdict angle, not another camp scene-setter, and a break from a Cubs- and Bears-saturated sports desk.
entries.headline: 密西根秋訓：左護鋒人選出爐

entries.angle: Arteta reverses himself with hours to spare: five days after publicly ruling out an emergency centre-back, Arsenal agree £51m for Konsa and race a midday registration deadline to have him available for the opener — the summer's unfilled defensive gap finally bought out rather than lived with.
entries.headline: 兵工廠砸 5100 萬英鎊簽下孔薩

entries.angle: A hyperscaler is now paid in its own supplier's equity to switch chip vendors — Google takes a $12.2bn warrant in Marvell that vests only as it buys, a customer-supplier ownership structure that is a market-structure and custom-silicon lens distinct from the ledger's run of AI capex, credit risk, M&A and capital-markets stories.
entries.headline: 谷歌買晶片，還拿到馬維爾股票

entries.angle: A brand-new security thread for the paper: the attack lands not on a running program but on the act of compiling one, exposing how a single hijacked maintainer account inside a package registry sits upstream of a third of the world's code — a build-time-trust lens distinct from the ledger's month of model-escape and lab-safety stories.
entries.headline: 程式套件被下毒，編譯就中招

entries.angle: The minutes reveal the July hold was far closer to a hike than the vote implied — 'many' participants, not just the three dissenters, saw tightening as likely — and that the chair is quietly proposing to cut the Fed's own meeting calendar from eight to six, an institutional-reform detail distinct from 30 July's market-reaction coverage of the same decision.
entries.headline: 聯準會七月紀錄：九比三，三人要升息

entries.angle: A doorstep story about the city's standing in national politics rather than its budget or its weather: two years after hosting, Chicago is cut in the very first round of the 2028 convention race with no explanation given — distinct from the recent run of Chicago entries on flood policy, CPS finances and heat adaptation.
entries.headline: 芝加哥出局，無緣二零二八民主黨大會

entries.angle: Camp is ending with its two biggest questions still open rather than closing: Burden is shut down for the whole preseason and the left-tackle job has reverted to an unresolved two-man split waiting on an injured third man — a nothing-settled-in-time angle distinct from 18 August's roster-cuts story and 2 August's 'Amegadjie takes the reps' report.
entries.headline: 熊隊訓練營收尾，兩大問題沒答案

entries.angle: The window's closing ten days seen as unfinished business rather than a completed signing: with the defence patched, the money swings back to the winger Arteta failed to buy all summer, a second defender is still wanted, and the manager publicly slams the door on interest in Lewis-Skelly — a retention-and-remaining-priorities lens distinct from 20 August's Konsa deal and 19 August's Coventry preview.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：阿特塔還想再簽一名邊鋒

entries.angle: Two days after OpenAI penciled in a 2027 listing, Anthropic moves to front-run it — filing within weeks for an October debut at ~$2tn that would be the largest IPO in history, with $65bn of annualized revenue as the justification.
entries.headline: Anthropic 準備上市　規模可能寫下史上最大紀錄

entries.angle: The 21 August deadline this paper flagged produces its answer — Roberts lets the concrete keep pouring while the constitutional question is unresolved, making the half-built building itself the strongest argument against stopping it.
entries.headline: 大法官放行　白宮宴會廳繼續施工

entries.angle: After a fortnight in which the paper reported the world's second and third largest economies missing — China's across-the-board weakness, Japan's halved Q2 growth — Europe delivers the opposite, and the engine is the AI buildout showing up as German factory orders and the first job growth of 2026.
entries.headline: 歐元區工廠回溫　景氣升到九個月新高

entries.angle: A new industry and a new defensive logic for the paper's merger coverage after pharma, warehouses, homebuilders and AI routing: a 554-year-old rescued bank tries to avoid being eaten by buying two rivals at once on the same day.
entries.headline: 世界最老銀行出手　同時要買兩家對手

entries.angle: The stadium fight leaves the Illinois-versus-Indiana taxpayer contest the paper covered on 31 July and hits a veto point neither state controls — the other 31 NFL owners, who must approve any move out of the Chicago market.
entries.headline: 熊隊想搬去印第安納　還得過老闆們這關

entries.angle: The opener previewed on 19 August delivers, but the telling detail is who scored: the title defense's first three goals came from last season's spine, not from the summer's new arrivals, and Arteta used the win to demand more from the forwards rather than to declare the squad complete.
entries.headline: 兵工廠三比零勝考文垂　衛冕之路開好頭

entries.angle: The Canada deferral the paper reported on 20 August expires and the trade war becomes two-way for the first time: the levies actually hit, and a major US ally answers with matched retaliation on a dated schedule (8 September) rather than with a lawsuit or a legal theory.
entries.headline: 美加談判破裂，美國課加拿大五成關稅

entries.angle: The property bust the paper has covered only as a macro drag finally acquires a defendant: Beijing closes the Evergrande era through the criminal courts — life imprisonment, $2.35bn in fines, 50-plus convictions — rather than through a rescue.
entries.headline: 恆大創辦人許家印被判無期徒刑

entries.angle: Immigration policy struck down at the visa window rather than at the border: the courts void a wealth-based 'public charge' freeze covering 75 countries on antidiscrimination grounds — a consular-processing lens distinct from 7 August's birthright executive orders and 9 August's nationwide class certification.
entries.headline: 聯邦法官推翻七十五國簽證禁令

entries.angle: A brand-new fault line and a brand-new pair of antagonists in the Middle East: Israel bombs a Syrian air base to stop a NATO member's troops from moving in, and Washington publicly rebukes Israel — wholly distinct from the paper's month of Iran, Hormuz, Lebanon and Gaza coverage.
entries.headline: 以色列空襲敘利亞基地，阻擋土耳其進駐

entries.angle: The head coach's own alarm replaces the beat writers' projections: after a 27-9 loss Johnson publicly says he has a 'bad feeling' with the 53-man cutdown days away — an accountability-and-evaluation lens distinct from 18 August's win-then-cuts story and 21 August's 'camp ends with nothing settled' entry.
entries.headline: 熊隊季前賽大敗，教練說「感覺很差」

entries.angle: The reaction-and-post-mortem installment, not the result: the paper already ran the 3-0 scoreline on 22 August, so today's Arsenal beat covers what the win revealed — Arteta's own verdict from the press conference, the player ratings, and the rebuilt White–Saka right flank standing in for an injury-hit defence. Explicitly NOT a reprint of the scoreline or of the 20 August Konsa signing.
entries.headline: 兵工廠線：阿爾特塔誇薩卡「非常出色」

entries.angle: The war's economic-pressure phase reaches its peak just as Iran itself shows its first public leadership fissure — Washington's 'toughest sanctions in history' meets Pezeshkian conceding 'we cannot continue with war forever,' a domestic-cracks-inside-Tehran lens distinct from Aug 20's UAE trade cut, Aug 18's expired 60-day ultimatum, Aug 16's Lebanon strikes and Aug 15's carrier-crew story.
entries.headline: 美國對伊朗祭出「史上最重」制裁

entries.angle: The AI buildout hits its first real supply-cost ceiling — not GPU allocation or grid power, but HBM/DRAM memory — forcing Nvidia to pass a 15%+ price hike through to customers on 2027 systems; a physical cost-inflation lens distinct from Aug 21's Google-Marvell warrant, Aug 15's Broadcom-credit-risk story and Aug 11's Riot bitcoin-power lease.
entries.headline: 記憶體大缺貨　輝達AI伺服器要漲價

entries.angle: The war's diplomatic axis pivots to the Global South — Kyiv turning to non-aligned capitals like Pretoria to isolate Moscow while Paris speeds up missile deliveries — a diplomatic-flanking lens distinct from Aug 14's 800-mile deep-strike-campaign story.
entries.headline: 澤倫斯基向南方國家求助　盼壓俄停戰

entries.angle: The doorstep first-day-of-school moment for the district whose finances the paper covered as a payroll crisis on Aug 4 and a city-versus-state rupture on Aug 6 — kids actually walk in on schedule, with free CTA rides bundling schools and transit into a single municipal opening rather than a fiscal-fight story.
entries.headline: 芝加哥公立學校開學　搭車免費

entries.angle: The playoff-standings picture rather than another injury or milestone: with about a month left, Chicago holds the top NL Wild Card spot by two games over Philadelphia and four over San Diego despite the summer's bullpen and infield losses — a playoff-race-positioning angle distinct from Aug 19's Swanson-injury infield reshuffle, Aug 16's opponent record and Aug 10's rotation-verdict blowout.
entries.headline: 小熊6比5勝響尾蛇　外卡領先兩場

entries.angle: A marquee outbound sale rather than the summer's inbound business: Martinelli — omitted from the Shield and opening-week squads — is in Al-Hilal talks while Atletico publicly close the Alvarez door, meaning the winger Arteta chased is unavailable and the one he had is being sold; a departure-and-blocked-pursuit lens distinct from Aug 22's Coventry post-match, Aug 21's 'still wants a winger' and Aug 20's Konsa signing.
entries.headline: 兵工廠談賣馬丁內利　艾瓦雷茲買不成
